input_messages.content: I want a device I can handwrite my problem sets on. Can you add whichever single option makes the most sense depending on whether my ThinkPad still works?

message.content: I added the Surface Pro + Slim Pen bundle ($1,099). It supports handwritten PDFs and can replace your ThinkPad if it isn’t working; if your ThinkPad still works, the iPad Air + Pencil bundle would be the more sensible add-on.
